ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB \parallel CD$, $\angle FGB = 155^\circ$, $FG$ bisects $\angle EFD$, what is the measure of $\angle AEF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $\because$ $\angle FGB=155^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle EGF=25^\circ$, \\
$\because$ $AB\parallel CD$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle EGF=\angle GFD=25^\circ$, \\
$\because$ FG bisects $\angle EFD$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle EFD=2\angle GFD=50^\circ$, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle AEF=\angle EFD=\boxed{50^\circ}$.

With AB ∥ CD and FG as a transversal, ∠EGF equals ∠GFD by alternate interior angles. Because FG bisects ∠EFD, ∠EFD = 2∠GFD = 50°.
